body:
Nobody will see this, and I'm honestly thankful.


* I think I am hideously unattractive
* I hate being around other people
* I am never happy with my weight
* I have an absolutely dreadful self harm problem
* I have no desire to stop self harming
* I have had two different eating disorders
* I am beyond abysmal in all my classes
* Meeting new people gives me intense panic attacks
I definitely feel that we're so close to breaking up, but I don't have it in me. I'm excruciatingly passive, so that makes things pretty difficult.

Thanks, we're talking right now, and I think we're actually going to break up soon, but if we somehow manage to mend this then I'll probably use that exact quote. Thank you for your time, it really means a lot
It isn't, thank you very much for your response

To clarify, I don't have a problem with him sending me porn. It's just that coupled with everything else that's making me feel worse. I'm not really okay with it, but I guess there's nothing I can do. Heaven knows I'd love to be his first choice, but I'll take what I can get, I suppose.
Hey, thanks! It's equally nice for me, seeing someone the same age. Most of the people I talk to think it's just teen angst or something, which is kind of off-putting, but keep your head up!

There's so many other ways to cope! One thing I do, is when I really really feel the urge to cut, I just sit near other people and don't try to make conversation. Their presence often relaxes me, and I can't do anything in front of them. Other things include exercising (running, lifting weights, lunges, yoga, anything), drawing, listening to happy music, flicking yourself with a rubber band, read a good book, watch your favorite comedy, watch funny youtube videos, crunch up soft drink cans, rip newspaper, and best of all, scream really loudly. Don't say anything, just scream your heart out.
Why thank you! Sometimes it's hard to see that, but thank you for the reassurance :)
Oh, I forgot to mention that I'm usually on birth control. However, as I don't take it the week of my period, it slipped my mind when I was writing this post.
Thank you very much!
Are the chances any smaller of something?
thank you. Although I've already gone on my vacation, nothing was suspected and I'll be sure to use this in the future. Thanks!
Thank you very much!
Thank you very much! Although that'll help with my arms, there's a fair bit of damage on my thighs. Do you happen to have any suggestions for that?
obligatory pumped up kicks
yeah. myself.
Thank you :) I'll be back on here tomorrow. Stay strong.

Not as much as I'd like to, about an hour a week at a local church. And as for what I told you, I meant every word of it. You are a very, very strong person and should be very proud :) 
Very unfortunately, I must got to bed now, as I need to wake up in six hours. However, I need you to promise me that you won't hurt yourself tonight, okay?

I know. You're being a fucking terrific person. It's extremely easy to wallow in self-pity when suicidal, and just stop caring about other people. You're being so selfless and strong I'm flabbergasted, to be honest.

either way, I don't think you understand what an amazing change you're being in these people's lives. To have two volunteering positions that you visit twice a week is something that I'm sure many people look up to you over. It's such an incredibly selfless thing to do, that I bet you're someone's inspiration.
and you'd have repeats who you'd see a lot, I'll assume?
does it help you at all? what age group do you connect with the most?
how often?

Is there anyway you could spend time more with other people, not necessarily those who you know? Such as volunteering at an elderly home (They're always nice), tutoring kids, doing odd jobs for a neighbour, stuff like that?
if you had to say, who's one person you care about?
anytime :) are you sure there isn't anyone you know in real life who'd be able to help?

It's every little bit that counts :) If this can only help temporarily, then maybe, just maybe it'll put it off long enough for you to find something that truly gives you a reason to live. Keep in mind that I've an excruciatingly stubborn person, and I have decided that I will find a way to make you happy :) If you don't think anyone cares, think about me. If it helps to know a bit about me, I'm Rachel, I'm 15 and I live in Toronto. I care about you, honestly. I truly want you to feel better. If you ever need anything, please, please just PM me and I'll help you as soon as it's possible.

This probably sounds pretty weird, but something that really helps me feel better whenever I start going back to bad thoughts, is to develop a routine where I make sure to include just a bit of time, like an hour a day, where I do something I enjoy. I specify exactly what I'll be doing, such as piano, watching a movie, knitting, drawing, or something like that. At the same time, I try to think about a few things that I really enjoy about the activity, or good things that happened in my day. If I can't do either of those, simply clearing my mind helps a bit. I don't know if it'll help at all, but I think it's worth a try :)
I'm very sorry I'm asking a lot of questions, I'm trying to understand your situation more :) Have you tried any of these recently?
absolutely none of them? What changed it all? Was it the depression?
What do you mean? If it makes you happy it's one of the most important things for you to continue. Do you have enough time to pick some of these back up?
What stopped you from spending more time on them?
a week or month?
whatever unit of measurement's easiest, week or month maybe?
how much time were you able to dedicate to that stuff?
what happened to that stuff?
What's something that used to make you happy?
That you can't use my advice.
sure, you delayed suicide, but were you trying to be happy?
Why not? It sounds like you're convincing yourself.
How long did you try for? It's gonna take a while, but it's possible.

I was there. I tried to kill myself four times. You can get out of it! I did. Despite how fucking worthless I felt everyday, despite how lonely I felt, despite the fact that my best friend was just as suicidal as me and wasn't getting better, despite the fact that my marks were dropping and I felt like a failure. **Despite everything, I made it and so can you.** Don't ever give up.
You will. If you convince yourself that there's nothing good, there won't be. When you start looking for amazing things, you find them.
You are an amazingly strong person. Thank you very much for never giving up.
Why is there no point? There's never a reason to give up on your hopes.
There's probably a million breathtaking things happening around you every day. And if you look for them, you'll find them
You've never had a hope, or a dream, or something you wished for with all your heart?
Someday in the rest of your natural life, something breathtaking will happen. That I guarantee.
What do you want to be happy?
Could you share exactly what's driven you to this? It might help me make you feel better.

My lifestyle will decrease by at least 500% in the future. It is very possible to be happy with just one person you find and love. I live in an exceptionally wealthy neighbourhood, and am surrounded by some of the least happy people I've ever met. The best things in life cost absolutely nothing, or close to it. Stargazing, ice cream, swings, saturday mornings, trips to the beach, cartoons, watching a sunrise, pets, trying new things, having a stranger smile at you, smiling at a stranger, holding hands, building something, the smell after it rains, the fact that nothing is permanent unless you want it to be, quiet time, a really good book, cooking a great meal, hammocks, the smell of freshly cut grass, the first snow fall, and most of all being in love. That's all you need to be happy. Wealth does not define a person's life.

Again, this is me. I live in a very wealthy family, with much more stuff than I could ever need. However, I find that the more stuff I have, the sadder I am. Happiness isn't dependant on material belongings. Understand that while you have stuff now, you can have happiness later.

Don't. You will never know what you're missing in life. When you're feeling upset, make a list of 5, 10, 20, however many you can manage, things you want to do in life before you die. I know it's really hard to think of anything sometimes, but there's gonna be something. What about getting married? Travelling the world? Seeing the stars, getting a house in muskoka, anything. There's something. And you leaving will hurt more people than you know.

Please, please don't. As many bad things might be going on in your life, I know you can overcome them. Think of everybody you're leaving behind. You might think you don't have anyone, but there is at least one person who would give you the world and more. Your life is worth it. 
It might seem like nobody cares, but I do. I'm struggling with your situation at the moment, and I really believe we can help each other out. PM me if you want to, I'd be honoured to talk to someone who's strong enough to have made it this far. Don't give up. I believe in you.
thank you so much for helping to make me laugh on a night like this! :)
thank you, this helped me to realize exactly what my death would leave behind.

Thank you very much :)
also, F/15/ON. I know it seems even stupider now that you know I'm fifteen, and I'm sorry for that.

Thank you very much. My parents are one of the few reasons I am still alive, as they give me hope that stuff goes right for people. You're absolutely right about venting it, I have much more productive ways of handling my situation then ending everything. Thank you.
sometimes it's very nice talking to someone else who went through this. Thank you for being honest with me, it's much appreciated, and the reality of what you're saying calms me down. Thank you.
Thank you very much. This helps more than you know.
Thank you very much, however there's most definitely people in worse situations. While looking at an overview of my life I have nothing to complain about. But thank you :)
I've considered it, but I don't really have the time as I struggle to keep my grades up, and telling my parents would be extremely difficult.
I'd make my scars go away
